name: Mercury
defines: How you think and communicate — the way you take information in, sort it, and hand it back to other people.

aries.definition: Fast, direct thinking. You reach a conclusion quickly and state it plainly, and you would rather be corrected than be slow.
aries.showsUp: You interrupt when you have got there first, you argue to sharpen an idea rather than to win, and long preambles lose you.

taurus.definition: Slow, concrete thinking. You need to turn a thing over before you will commit to a view, and once you have, it stays put.
taurus.showsUp: You are hard to hurry into an opinion and harder to talk out of one, and you trust what you can see and touch over what you have been told.

gemini.definition: Quick, wide-ranging thinking. Mercury is at home here: you take in a great deal at once and connect things nobody put next to each other.
gemini.showsUp: You are a natural talker and explainer, you have several conversations and tabs going at once, and you get bored before a subject is finished.

cancer.definition: Thinking coloured by feeling and memory. You reason from what you have lived, and you remember the tone of a conversation long after its content.
cancer.showsUp: You take remarks personally, you recall what someone said years ago almost verbatim, and you communicate more through warmth than through precision.

leo.definition: Confident, performed thinking. You are interested in ideas that can be told well, and you speak with the whole of yourself behind the words.
leo.showsUp: You are a good storyteller, you speak in definite statements, and you take disagreement with your ideas as disagreement with you.

virgo.definition: Precise, analytical thinking. Mercury is strongest here: you break a thing into parts, test each one, and find the flaw.
virgo.showsUp: You correct details others let pass, you write and edit carefully, and you can worry a problem long past the point of usefulness.

libra.definition: Comparative thinking. You cannot see one side without immediately seeing the other, which makes you fair and makes deciding hard.
libra.showsUp: You phrase things diplomatically, you weigh options at length, and you argue the missing side of a debate almost involuntarily.

scorpio.definition: Penetrating thinking. You are not satisfied with the stated reason and keep going until you have the real one.
scorpio.showsUp: You ask the question everyone else avoided, you notice what is being left out, and you keep your own conclusions to yourself until you are ready.

sagittarius.definition: Big-picture thinking. You reach for the principle behind the particulars and are impatient with detail that does not serve it.
sagittarius.showsUp: You speak in generalisations and get caught out on specifics, you say what you think without editing, and you learn best by going and seeing.

capricorn.definition: Structured, practical thinking. You want to know what a thing is for and whether it will hold, and you say only what you can stand behind.
capricorn.showsUp: You are economical with words, dry rather than effusive, and slow to state a view you have not yet checked.

aquarius.definition: Original, systemic thinking. You see the pattern and the exception at once, and you are drawn to the idea that overturns the assumption.
aquarius.showsUp: You take contrary positions to test them, you explain things in terms of how the whole system works, and you can be coolly logical about things people feel strongly about.

pisces.definition: Associative, impressionistic thinking. You understand things whole before you can explain them in parts, and you often know without being able to say how.
pisces.showsUp: You think in images and metaphors, you lose the thread of literal detail, and your first impression of a person is usually right.
